class.name: SHLighting
class.description: SH is stored as a [PackedColorArray] of 9 coefficients (only red, green and blue are used; alpha stays [code]0[/code]). [method evaluate_irradiance] returns irradiance divided by pi, so a uniform radiance L yields exactly L. Order: Y00, Y1-1(y), Y10(z), Y11(x), Y2-2(xy), Y2-1(yz), Y20, Y21(xz), Y22. Algorithms follow Ramamoorthi and Hanrahan, "An Efficient Representation for Irradiance Environment Maps" (2001) and Sloan, "Stupid Spherical Harmonics Tricks" (2008).

method.name: basis
method.description: Returns the 9 SH basis values for a unit direction.

method.name: fibonacci_dir
method.description: Returns direction [param i] of [param n] evenly distributed on the sphere (Fibonacci lattice).

method.name: accumulate
method.description: Returns [param sh] plus a radiance sample from [param dir] (already weighted by its solid angle).

method.name: project_direction
method.description: Projects a single weighted radiance sample coming from [param dir].

method.name: add
method.description: Returns the sum of two SH sets.

method.name: evaluate_radiance
method.description: Reconstructs band-limited radiance in direction [param dir].

method.name: evaluate_irradiance
method.description: Returns cosine-convolved irradiance divided by pi around [param normal], clamped to be non-negative.

method.name: from_sky
method.description: Builds SH from an analytic sky: a ground-to-sky gradient over the Y axis plus an optional directional sun (its colour is the irradiance on a surface facing it).

method.name: rotate
method.description: Rotates the lighting function by [param rotation] via quadrature (error around 1e-2).
